spanish: Sea reunido Aarón a sus pueblos, porque no entrará a la tierra que di a hijos de Israel, sobre que amargaron mi boca en aguas de Meribá.

findings.issue: Qal perfect 2mp of H4784 (rebel) is rendered amargaron (make bitter), a different verb with mi boca as its object.
Niphal imperfect 3ms is rendered as the jussive subjunctive Sea rather than an imperfect will-be-gathered.
The preposition lamed (to/at) is rendered en (in).

notes: Aarón, plural pueblos, Israel, and Meribá match the names and the plural of עַמָּיו.
